en: For the Chief Musician. By David.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

en: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
u.src: 1  The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

p.src: 2  The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

en: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
u.src: 2  The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

p.src: 3  They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

ja: を外れた。 共に腐敗した。
en: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
u.src: 3  They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

p.src: 4  Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?
u.src: 4  Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

p.src: 5  There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

ja: のうちにおられるからだ。
en: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
u.src: 5  There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

p.src: 6  You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

ja: 画をくじこうとする。 しかし、
en: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
u.src: 6  You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

p.src: 7  Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

ja: されるとき、 ヤコブは
en: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
u.src: 7  Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
